units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:14">Gen. R. s. 85</cite>, end <he>פ׳ בבליא</he> a Babylonian purple cloak; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 18:15">Yalk. Josh. 18</cite> <he>פורפירא בבליקון</he>). Lam. R. beg., v. <cite ref="Q00381">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 35:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 13</cite> <he>כותבו בפ׳ שלו</he> marks it (with blood) on his purple; Yalk. ib. 645 <he>בפורפירא</he> (some ed. <he>בפורפיר</he>); v. next w.—Pl. <he>פּוּרְפַּרְיָאוֹת</he>, interch. with <cite ref="Q01965"><he>פּוֹרְפְּרָאוֹת</he></cite>.
